messages:
Ana Gomez: quick proposal: run a 6-week pilot for a micro-check/escalation ladder to reduce stale postmortem actions. idea = short daily batching + tiered escalations. thoughts?
Tom Rivers: sounds useful. define micro-check?
Ana Gomez: owner posts a 1-line update weekly for items >7d. OpsWatcher batches reminders once per day. if missed, escalate: verifier at 14d, sponsor at 21d, exec alert at 30d for P0/P1 recurring items.
Priya Shah: configurable windows per severity please. low-risk can be 21/28/45 etc.
incident-bot: Tip: use `/incident-track create --template micro-check` to prefill owner/verifier fields.
Tom Rivers: avoid spam pls. batch only 1 summary per person per day.
OpsWatcher: will batch: summary includes item id, owner, status, blocker, next step.
Ana Gomez: recurrence automation: if a service shows in 3 PMs within 90 days, auto-tag `recurrence:<service>` and shorten windows.
Priya Shah: dashboard idea: columns = New / Awaiting micro-check / Verifier review / Sponsor / Blocked / Closed. add `next_touch` column for week focus.
Tom Rivers: metrics to track: closure time, #escalations, % missed micro-checks, blocked reasons.
Ana Gomez: pilot plan: onboard payments + search teams, measure noise vs closure. responsibilities: Priya = docs + demo (3d), Tom = OpsWatcher config & filters (2d), Ana = metrics + coordination.
Priya Shah: will draft 1-pager and a 5-min demo.
Tom Rivers: I'll post the Jira filter link when ready.
Ana Gomez: decision: run 6-week pilot with opt-in teams, daily batched micro-check reminders, configurable ladder, and recurrence-based priority bumps. prefix any quick issues with `pilot-signal:` in this thread.
incident-bot: Scheduled: daily micro-check summary at 08:00 for #incidents.
Tom Rivers: ack, starting config today.
Priya Shah: ack, drafting docs.
Ana Gomez: thanks — keeping it small and measurable.
